title: FloofyCrew registry index (index.json, schema 1)
description: The signed JSON index of a mod registry (Requirement 8.1). The detached signature over the canonical form lives beside it in index.json.sig; the index itself never embeds one.

source.description: The registry's own label (github:org/repo, or a package name). Informational: a client namespaces collisions by the source name the USER configured, never by this claim.

floofycrew.description: The FloofyCrew release the index was built with (informational).

hostVersion.description: A host version as the host prints it (floofy_core.semver.HostVersion; the same pattern as compat.schema.json): X.Y.Z (public), X.Y.Z.N (internal), X.Y.ZrcN / X.Y.Z.devN / X.Y.Z-insider.N (public pre-releases).

repo.description: The mod's source repository (an https URL, or an internal package name on a registry whose clients know how to resolve it).

kirocrew.description: The host base-version range from the manifest's kirocrew.version.

compat.description: Per host version: tested | expected | broken (the matrix cells for this mod@version, folded in from compat.json).

files.description: An ASSET record lists downloadable archives {url, sha256, size}; a LINK record (with `link`) lists the checkout's files {path, sha256, size} so a client can verify the clone file by file (Requirement 8.9). One shape per record, never mixed.

dependencies.description: The manifest's dependsOn: id -> range, or id -> {range, reason}.

channel.description: The mod's own release channel (stable, beta, …).

tag.description: The release tag the archive is published under; equals `version` (Requirement 8.2) unless the repository prefixes it (v1.2.0).

kinds.description: The part kinds the mod ships (from the manifest), so clients can show what a mod does before downloading.

app.description: Present when the mod is a pure App Kit app (a single `app` part): what the KiroCrew-compatible app-registry.json row needs (Requirement 8.6).

yanked.description: Set when the version was withdrawn; clients never pick a yanked version automatically.

changelog.description: Optional https URL of this version's release notes (release.json `changelog`, else the manifest's links.changelog); the manager shows it beside an available update (Requirement 16.6) and falls back to the mod's repo.

oneOf.description: asset record: no `link`, every files[] entry names an https URL
link record: `link` present, every files[] entry names a path inside the checkout

link.description: Where a link-based version lives (Requirement 8.9): the repository (ssh:// or https:// only — the transport a client fetches over with its own credentials), the commit the version is pinned at (fetched directly by the client, so no tag is needed to locate a version), the SHA-256 of the canonical floofy.json, and the mod's directory inside the repository when it is not the root. Optional: ref, the branch the record was made from (the default branch when absent), and tag, kept by records made before commits were pinned. A client refuses a checkout whose canonical-manifest hash or files[] differ.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the mod root (the manifest's rule): no leading '/', no '..' segment, no backslashes or control characters.

file.description: One files[] entry: {url, sha256, size[, name]} in an asset record (an https archive), or {path, sha256, size} in a link record (a file of the checkout, verified after the clone). Never both url and path.
